verdict_reason: Row building is correct and tested, but the new linesOfCode helper is a third copy of the lines-under-a-code filter.

todos.issue: New helper linesOfCode (selected-rows.js:9-10) is the third copy of the 'lines under one commodity code' rule: view-model/groups.js:15-17 filters lines by entry.commodityCode === code inline, and remove/post-remove.js:42-44 removes by the same comparison. lines.js already owns commodityCodesOf, the grouping key, but not the filter that goes with it.
todos.fix: Must: one function in lines.js owns which lines belong to a commodity code; selected-rows.js and groups.js call it, and post-remove.js keeps its inverse in step with it. One way: export linesOfCode(lines, code) from lines.js beside commodityCodesOf, delete the local copy here and use it in linesForGroup.
